# ACE Electronics Ghana — Project Instructions

## Project

- This is an existing Next.js e-commerce storefront for ACE Electronics Ghana.
- It uses a WhatsApp-first sales model; do not add or restore a conventional checkout, cart payment flow, or related ordering assumption.
- Preserve the existing Supabase integration and product catalogue.
- Never invent database schemas or undocumented API behaviour.

## Design

- Follow a minimal Apple/Xiaomi-inspired interface style.
- Use the background color `#F5F5F7`.
- Use the primary blue `#0066CC`.
- Use Space Grotesk and Inter typography.
- Product images must display complete product silhouettes without cropping.
- Do not introduce per-product “Verified Authentic” badges.

## Development Rules

- Preserve existing architecture and functioning features.
- Make the smallest safe implementation for the requested scope.
- Do not perform unnecessary redesigns or full-file rewrites.
- Reuse existing components and dependencies.
- Avoid unnecessary package installations.
- Inspect relevant files before modifying them.
- Ask before destructive or major architectural changes.

## Git Safety

- Inspect Git status before making changes.
- Never overwrite uncommitted work.
- Never force-push or delete branches.
- Do not commit or push without explicit authorization.

## Workflow

1. Understand the task.
2. Inspect relevant files.
3. Identify the smallest safe implementation.
4. Implement only the requested scope.
5. Run relevant checks.
6. Report modified files and actual test results.

## Communication

- Be concise and avoid repetitive investigations.
- Report errors honestly.
- Stop when the task is complete.
